func (r *htmlRenderer) extractFenceLanguage(node *ast.FencedCodeBlock, src []byte) string {
	r.migFenceLang = ""
	if node == nil {
		return ""
	}
	langWithAttributes := string(node.Language(src))
	lang, _, _ := strings.Cut(langWithAttributes, "{")
	r.migFenceLang = lang
	r.captureLangLead(lang)
	r.measureLangLead(lang)
	return lang
}

func (r *htmlRenderer) parseFenceAttributes(node *ast.FencedCodeBlock, infostr []byte) ([]ast.Attribute, string, error) {
	r.migAttrRaw = string(infostr)
	if node != nil && node.Attributes() != nil {
		return node.Attributes(), "", nil
	}
	if infostr != nil {
		attrStartIdx := -1
		attrEndIdx := -1
		for idx, char := range infostr {
			if attrEndIdx == -1 && char == '{' {
				attrStartIdx = idx
			}
			if attrStartIdx != -1 && char == '}' {
				attrEndIdx = idx
				break
			}
		}
		if attrStartIdx != -1 && attrEndIdx != -1 {
			n := ast.NewTextBlock()
			attrStr := infostr[attrStartIdx : attrEndIdx+1]
			r.migAttrRaw = string(attrStr)
			if attrs, hasAttr := parser.ParseAttributes(text.NewReader(attrStr)); hasAttr {
				for _, attr := range attrs {
					n.SetAttribute(attr.Name, attr.Value)
				}
				return n.Attributes(), "", nil
			}
			return nil, string(attrStr), errors.New("failed to parse Markdown attributes; you may need to quote the values")
		}
	}
	return nil, "", nil
}
